records_location.name: records_location
records_location.value:
coalesce(jsonb_typeof("records_fragments"."location") = 'object' and case "records_fragments"."location"->>'kind'
 when 'document' then jsonb_typeof("records_fragments"."location"->'paragraph') = 'string' and length(trim("records_fragments"."location"->>'paragraph')) > 0 and (not ("records_fragments"."location" ? 'page') or (jsonb_typeof("records_fragments"."location"->'page') = 'number' and ("records_fragments"."location"->>'page')::numeric > 0 and ("records_fragments"."location"->>'page')::numeric = trunc(("records_fragments"."location"->>'page')::numeric)))
 when 'spreadsheet' then jsonb_typeof("records_fragments"."location"->'sheet') = 'string' and length(trim("records_fragments"."location"->>'sheet')) > 0 and jsonb_typeof("records_fragments"."location"->'cell') = 'string' and length(trim("records_fragments"."location"->>'cell')) > 0
 when 'snapshot_field' then jsonb_typeof("records_fragments"."location"->'fieldPath') = 'string' and length(trim("records_fragments"."location"->>'fieldPath')) > 0 and (not ("records_fragments"."location" ? 'originalLocation') or jsonb_typeof("records_fragments"."location"->'originalLocation') = 'string')
 when 'recording' then jsonb_typeof("records_fragments"."location"->'startMs') = 'number' and jsonb_typeof("records_fragments"."location"->'endMs') = 'number' and ("records_fragments"."location"->>'startMs')::numeric >= 0 and ("records_fragments"."location"->>'endMs')::numeric > ("records_fragments"."location"->>'startMs')::numeric and ("records_fragments"."location"->>'startMs')::numeric = trunc(("records_fragments"."location"->>'startMs')::numeric) and ("records_fragments"."location"->>'endMs')::numeric = trunc(("records_fragments"."location"->>'endMs')::numeric)
 else false end, false)

records_statement_attribution.name: records_statement_attribution
records_statement_attribution.value: ("records_statements"."kind" = 'ai_inference' and "records_statements"."author_id" is null and "records_statements"."model_version" is not null and length(trim("records_statements"."model_version")) > 0) or ("records_statements"."kind" <> 'ai_inference' and "records_statements"."author_id" is not null and "records_statements"."model_version" is null)

talent_ai_status_value.name: talent_ai_status_value
talent_ai_status_value.value: ("talent_ai_suggestions"."status" = 'scored' and "talent_ai_suggestions"."value" between 1 and 5 and "talent_ai_suggestions"."value" is not null and "talent_ai_suggestions"."anchor_id" is not null) or ("talent_ai_suggestions"."status" in ('unknown','not_demonstrated') and "talent_ai_suggestions"."value" is null and "talent_ai_suggestions"."anchor_id" is null)

talent_confirmation_provenance.name: talent_confirmation_provenance
talent_confirmation_provenance.value: ("talent_confirmations"."source_category" = 'original' and "talent_confirmations"."evaluator_id" is not null and "talent_confirmations"."modified_by" is not null) or ("talent_confirmations"."source_category" = 'prototype_baseline' and "talent_confirmations"."confirmed_at" is null and "talent_confirmations"."modified_by" is null and "talent_confirmations"."revision" = 1 and ("talent_confirmations"."status" <> 'scored' or "talent_confirmations"."evaluator_id" is not null))

talent_confirmation_status_value.name: talent_confirmation_status_value
talent_confirmation_status_value.value: ("talent_confirmations"."status" = 'scored' and "talent_confirmations"."value" between 1 and 5 and "talent_confirmations"."value" is not null and "talent_confirmations"."anchor_id" is not null) or ("talent_confirmations"."status" in ('unknown','not_demonstrated') and "talent_confirmations"."value" is null and "talent_confirmations"."anchor_id" is null)

talent_confirmation_revision_chain.name: talent_confirmation_revision_chain
talent_confirmation_revision_chain.value: ("talent_confirmations"."revision" = 1 and "talent_confirmations"."previous_id" is null and "talent_confirmations"."previous_revision" is null) or ("talent_confirmations"."revision" > 1 and "talent_confirmations"."previous_id" is not null and "talent_confirmations"."previous_revision" = "talent_confirmations"."revision" - 1 and "talent_confirmations"."previous_revision" is not null and length(trim("talent_confirmations"."reason")) > 0 and "talent_confirmations"."reason" is not null)
